videos.script: A Deployment keeps a number of pods running, wherever the scheduler likes. Three other controllers change one of those words. {{three}} A DaemonSet does not take a number. It runs one pod on every node, and adds one when a node joins. Log collectors and node agents live here. {{daemon}} A Job does not keep pods running. It runs them until they succeed, a given number of times, and then it stops. When a pod fails, it tries again, a few times, then gives up and says so. {{job}} And a CronJob makes a Job on a schedule, like cron on a server. {{cron}} You will run all three, break one on purpose, and read the time a CronJob hides in the names of its Jobs. {{names}}
